title: NavLab 1 (1986) : Carnegie Mellon : Robotics Institute History of Self-Driving Cars
summary: A short CMU Robotics Institute clip on NavLab 1 from 1986, the first self-driving car to carry people on board. It was very slow but revolutionary for its era's computing power.
why: Cited as evidence that autonomous driving has been demonstrated for decades and that progress was slow.

quote.text: There was one at CMU back in the 1980s, the NavLab.
